name.description: Human-facing name of the agent. Used in logs, the runtime UI, and as the default exec-dir subfolder.

description.description: Short description of what this agent does.

preset.description: Named model preset that seeds the three complexity tiers and the per-role tier map. Overridden by explicit 'models' or LLM_MODEL* env vars.

models.description: Override individual tier model IDs. Any tier not listed falls back to the active preset.

low.description: Model ID for the low-complexity tier (routing, comms, lightweight review).

medium.description: Model ID for the medium-complexity tier (planning, implementation).

high.description: Model ID for the high-complexity tier (orchestrator escalation only).

roleTiers.description: Override which complexity tier each role uses. Any role not listed falls back to the preset's role map.

concurrency.description: Max concurrent in-flight LLM calls across all workstreams. Defaults to 2.

maxIterationsPerCall.description: Max tool-use iterations allowed within a single LLM call before forcing a stop. Defaults to 24.

port.description: HTTP port for the runtime server. Defaults to 4100.

execDir.description: Root directory where runs, workstreams, and workspace artifacts are persisted. Defaults to ~/.artificer/<name>.

watchInterval.description: Polling interval for the agent's own PRs and notifications (e.g. '5m', '30s'). Omit to disable.

executor.description: Worker executor backend for work roles (planner, worker, reviewer). Defaults to 'llm' (internal tool-use loop). Set to 'cursor-agent' to delegate work to the cursor agent CLI instead.

model.description: Model to pass to cursor agent via --model (e.g. 'claude-sonnet-4-5').

identity.description: Identity git sync settings — controls automatic commit/push of memories and config changes.

autoCommit.description: Commit changes to the identity repo automatically (memories, config updates). Default: false.

autoPush.description: Push commits to the remote after each autoCommit. Requires autoCommit: true. Default: false.

commitPrefix.description: Prefix for auto-generated commit messages. Default: 'memory:' for memories, 'config:' for config changes.

remote.description: Git remote name to push to. Default: 'origin'.

branch.description: Branch to push to. Default: the current branch.

modelTier.description: Complexity tier: low (cheap/fast), medium (balanced), high (most capable).
